core_problem_solved: To provide the low-level, streaming API for parsing (reading) and generating (writing) JSON, serving as the foundation for the Jackson 1.x series.
key_features: The original `JsonParser` and `JsonGenerator` streaming APIs for Jackson 1.x.
era_and_niche: The legacy core module for the Jackson 1.x series, hosted at the now-defunct Codehaus repository. This was the foundational piece of the original Jackson library.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **obsolete**. The entire Jackson project moved from Codehaus to the FasterXML organization and was rewritten as Jackson 2.x. The direct modern successor is **`com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core`**.
